content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-14|stripe]] for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-one-afternoon-fast-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-minimum-viable-stack-4|Payment Gateways]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments for digital products represent a shift in how creators can monetize their work. Instead of relying on traditional platforms that charge steep fees, Solana enables direct cryptocurrency transactions. This matters because it allows creators to retain more of their earnings. For instance, while Gumroad takes a 10% cut on every sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. At 100 sales of a $97 product, that difference results in an additional $921 retained by the creator. This infrastructure empowers creators to build sustainable businesses without dependency on restrictive payment platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Solana payments leverages decentralized technology, ensuring fast and secure transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is verified on the Solana blockchain, enabling automatic fulfillment of digital products. Utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, the backend logic is handled efficiently, allowing instant delivery of ebooks, courses, or templates. The infrastructure is designed for creators to own their entire system, with no recurring fees or platform dependencies. This architecture not only streamlines the payment process but also enhances the overall customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment solution is designed specifically for digital creators who have been locked out of mainstream payment platforms. Whether you're selling educational content, design assets, or software, the Solana system is tailored to help you reach a global audience without the financial constraints imposed by traditional payment processors. Regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable or limited will find this infrastructure particularly beneficial, as it enables creators to sell directly to customers and maintain control over their revenue. This is not just a workaround; it's a robust, sovereign solution.
Solana payments let you keep more of your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully implement Solana payments, several components work in harmony. First, you need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to display your products. Backend logic can be handled through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which also assists in automating order processing. For storing orders and customer data, options like Supabase or Google Sheets can be utilized. Finally, NOWPayments serves as the payment processor, enabling cryptocurrency transactions with minimal fees. Together, these elements create a seamless ecosystem that allows creators to manage their digital stores efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your Solana payment system, start by setting up a hosting solution like GitHub Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Choose a storage option, such as Supabase, for managing your product orders. Integrate NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency payments seamlessly. Finally, ensure that your digital products are ready for delivery, using a service like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting your files. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you gain access to all the blueprints and templates needed to streamline this process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
No platform fees mean more revenue for you as a creator.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in exploring how to set up your own digital download store without relying on conventional platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It offers all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for building and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

To sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe, use a blockchain-based payment processor like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept cryptocurrency. This solution ensures low fees and enables direct transactions with your customers.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to establish your own sovereign commerce stack using tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This way, you retain more of your sales revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without Gumroad or Payhip by setting up a dedicated online store using cryptocurrency payments. This approach allows you to bypass high platform fees.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This flexibility allows customers to pay in their preferred currency.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of just 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than many traditional platforms like Gumroad, which can charge up to 10%.
